create_transaction.description: Report a fee payment for your own application. Creates a payment transaction, marks the application as awaiting payment confirmation by a gamemaster and posts a payment message into the application conversation.

params.project_application_id_hidden[0]: ID of the application the payment is made for
params.project_payment_type_id[0]: ID of the project payment type (how the money was sent)
params.amount[0]: Payment amount in the project currency
params.payment_datetime[0]: Date and time of the payment; obligatory if the project asks for them
params.content[0]: Free-form comment about the payment for the gamemaster

accept_application.description: Accept an application transferred to you by another player: the application becomes yours. Works only if the offer is addressed to you and has not been declined yet.

params.obj_id: ID of the application being transferred

decline_application.description: Decline an offer to take over someone else's application. The application stays with its current owner.

params.obj_id: ID of the application being transferred

get_list_of_room_neighboors.description: Get the list of players accommodated in the given project room. Changes nothing.

add_neighboor_request.description: Invite another player to share your room. Checks that the application is yours, that the room is chosen in your application and that it has free places; the invitee receives a request.

params.room_id: ID of the room the player is invited to

get_list_of_groups.description: Get the lists of groups that will be added and removed when a character is selected in the application. Changes nothing — used to recalculate groups on a character switch.

params.obj_id: ID of the project character being selected
params.prev_obj_id: ID of the previously selected character whose groups must be removed
